query_clear_sky_data.name: Query clear-sky estimate
query_clear_sky_data.description: Return clear-sky estimate data for all sites or a specific site. The response includes start_date_time and end_date_time fields.

site.name: Site
site.description: Optional site id to filter the response to a single site.

start_date_time.description: Optional start datetime used to filter interval results.

end_date_time.name: End date/time
end_date_time.description: Optional end datetime used to filter interval results.
